# AVEVA

> AVEVA is the global leader in industrial software, providing digital transformation solutions for engineering, operations, and data management across manufacturing, energy, and process industries.

AVEVA offers a comprehensive suite of industrial software solutions including digital twins, cloud platforms, AI, and connected worker technologies. The company serves enterprise customers globally and maintains active partner, academic, and customer success programs.

## Key Topics

- Industrial Software
- Digital Transformation
- Digital Twin
- Industrial Cloud Platform
- Industrial AI
- Data Management
- Edge Management
- Connected Worker
- Manufacturing
- Energy & Infrastructure
- Engineering Operations
- Sustainability
- SaaS
- Customer Success
- Partner Ecosystem

## Core Solutions & Products

- [Industrial Software Solutions](https://www.aveva.com/en/solutions): AVEVA solutions overview for engineering, operations and data management
- [Industrial Cloud Platform & Software](https://www.aveva.com/en/solutions/digital-transformation/industrial-cloud-platform): CONNECT industrial cloud platform for real-time insights and data management
- [Industrial Digital Twin](https://www.aveva.com/en/solutions/digital-transformation/digital-twin): Industrial digital twin for asset performance and operational efficiency
- [Industrial AI](https://www.aveva.com/en/solutions/digital-transformation/artificial-intelligence): Industrial AI solutions for process improvement and predictive maintenance
- [Connected Worker Solutions](https://www.aveva.com/en/solutions/digital-transformation/connected-worker): Connected worker solutions with augmented reality and mobile operations
- [AVEVA Edge Management](https://www.aveva.com/en/solutions/digital-transformation/edge-management): Edge management for device provisioning and remote management
